sales_file.structure: parcel_id (13 chars: island '1' + zone + section + plat(3) + parcel(3) + CPR(4)) -> last <=2 recorded sales [price, date]

zip_join.url: https://services.arcgis.com/tNJpAOha4mODLkXz/arcgis/rest/services/LEGDAT_ADDRESS/FeatureServer/1 (City & County of Honolulu, parid+zip1; manifest raw/owners_oahu/MANIFEST.txt)

building_value.use: sensitivity only: house parcels with 2026 building value > 0 (excludes vacant-land parcels as of today)

source.checked_for_2026_sales: Honolulu ArcGIS org services (CadastralTables layers OWNALL/OWNDAT/OWNERTYPE/OWNMLT/ASMTGIS/ASMTPITT/LEGDAT/FACILITIES/SEPARATIONS; Cadastral_Tables_by_TMK; All_Parcels) - no sales/conveyance layer found; metadata saved in raw/mm_oahu_tiers/

method.window: 2019-01-01 onward; file holds only each parcel's last two recorded sales, so earlier years (2019-2020 especially) are undercounted relative to recent years
method.dedupe: multi-parcel deals collapsed by (price, date, first 6 chars of 13-char key = island+zone+section+plat). The literal 'first 8 digits' rule would NOT merge the task's example (two adjacent parcels, $15.81M on 2017-11-16, whose ids differ at char 8), so plat level was used; alternative counts in notes.dedupe_sensitivity
method.type: condo = CPR suffix (last 4 chars) != '0000'; house = '0000'; a multi-parcel deal mixing both = 'mixed' (counted in totals, not in house/condo). 'house' therefore includes vacant land, commercial, multi-family and other non-CPR parcels; 'condo' includes CPR'd single-family homes
method.zone: TMK zone = 2nd char of 13-char key (1st digit of 12-digit TMK)
method.zip: situs ZIP via LEGDAT_ADDRESS zip1; for multi-parcel deals the most common ZIP among parcels
method.median_suppression: zone and ZIP cells: median null when n < 5

2025.partial_note: Partial year: file ends 2025-09-26 and recording lag thins May-Sep 2025; see monthly counts.

2026_ytd.note: No 2026 sales in source file (last recorded date 2025-09-26).

3.label_approx: Honolulu east: Kapahulu/Kaimuki/Diamond Head/Kahala/Aina Haina/Hawaii Kai (approx.)

oahu_by_year_residential_class_only.note: Same as oahu_by_year but only deals whose parcels all carry 2026 ASMTPITT taxratecode '1' (inferred = Residential; holds ~87% of Oahu parcels). Excludes inferred hotel/resort (code 7, concentrated in Waikiki CPR units), commercial/industrial (3/4), agricultural (5) etc. Class is as of tax year 2026, not at time of sale.

code_reading_inferred.7: Hotel & Resort (inferred: 5,837 of 23,764 Waikiki 96815 CPR units)

crosscheck_hbr.note: HBR yearly count = sum of monthly sf_sales/condo_sales; HBR yearly median approximated as median of the 12 monthly medians (true annual median not in page_data). coverage = file deduped count / HBR count.

gaps: No 2026 transactions in the file (last recorded sale 2025-09-26): 2026 YTD counts, medians, tiers and top-15 cannot be produced from this source.
2025 is partial and lag-affected: deduped monthly counts fall from ~300-350 (Jan-Apr) to double digits by Aug-Sep; treat 2025 totals as Jan-Sep partial, and Jan-Apr as the only near-complete stretch.
Older years undercount: a parcel resold 2+ times since 2019 keeps only its two latest sales.

No land-use/property-class field joined: 'house' (CPR 0000) includes vacant land, commercial and apartment buildings; see house_vacant_land_sensitivity (2026 building value > 0) for a partial correction.
ZIP: 438 deduped 2019-2025 transactions had no LEGDAT ZIP match.
notes.outlier_2025: Top 2025 record ($65,750,000, 2025-03-11, ZIP 96816, TMK zone 3, single non-CPR parcel, 2026 tax class 1) is 2.75x the parcel's 2026 assessed land+building value (~$23.9M); unverified against press/MLS - treat as an outlier that may not be a typical single-family sale. Other 2025 top-15 prices are 0.7-1.4x assessed.
notes.top15_2025_mix: The unfiltered 2025 top-15 includes parcels with inferred commercial/industrial/hotel tax classes (codes 3/4/7); use top15.2025_residential_class_only for home-buyer framing.
notes.coverage_summary: Pooled 2019-2024: deduped file houses = 59.5% of HBR single-family sales, condos = 80.2% of HBR condo sales; file medians run ~5-10% (house) and ~12-17% (condo) above HBR monthly-median proxies. 2025 full-year coverage ~25% due to file end/recording lag; Jan-Apr 2025 ~61-63%.
notes.privacy: No parcel ids, owner names or street addresses in outputs.

notes_handoff: Individual sale-level lists (top sales by price/date/ZIP) were removed from this repo copy so no parcel-level transactions are exposed; aggregates are unchanged.
